initial_authoring_checkpoint.head: ed49cd00d7ef11763296bb61f3d6547da0c612f9
initial_authoring_checkpoint.reason: Pre-review adversarial analysis found that transfer classification had been stated too broadly. A continuation-to-receiver transfer is internal only when both owners are inside the selected control volume. The authoring package was remediated to make internal versus boundary classification explicitly control-volume relative.

counter_hypotheses.claim: Continuation mass can be folded into BANHST as long as the numerical total closes.
counter_hypotheses.basis: BANHST is explicitly soil-solution storage and continuation mass must remain finite at zero represented aqueous volume.

counter_hypotheses.claim: Continuation mass can be folded into BANHCX because both are non-aqueous.
counter_hypotheses.basis: Revision-53 soil-complex storage is Cxnh/Rscxnh over soil layers max(1,Ln1)..Ln2; SQ04 rejected direct continuation-to-soil ownership without a qualified transfer.
SQ05 and the user guide identify the virtual top reservoir as additions-specific.

counter_hypotheses.claim: Wet-to-continuation and rewetting transfers are always internal.
counter_hypotheses.basis: Internality is relative to selected control-volume membership. Cross-volume transfers require typed boundary terms.

counter_hypotheses.claim: The observer can reconstruct continuation mass from the balance residual, avoiding a persistent physical state.
counter_hypotheses.basis: SQ02 requires a persistent owner and restart state. Residual reconstruction would make accounting own physics and can mask unrelated defects.

counter_hypotheses.claim: Exact accounting closure proves the dry-phase or rewetting physics.
counter_hypotheses.basis: MASSQ04 qualifies observer semantics only; process laws remain unqualified in SQ03-SQ05.

counter_hypotheses.claim: An unspecified continuation loss may be reported under legacy BANHVO or BANHNT because those output categories already exist.
counter_hypotheses.basis: A named legacy output can be used only after the corresponding physical process, owner mapping, sign, units and ordering are separately qualified.

counter_hypotheses.claim: A legacy public balance field may silently change meaning if total mass conservation improves.
counter_hypotheses.basis: Versioned semantics and auditable component ownership are required; conservation does not justify semantic redefinition.

active_controls: Alterra Report 224 Annex 2 identifies distinct soil-solution and soil-complex NH4 storage terms and named external/process outputs.
Frozen revision-53 Outbal_Init/Outbal_calc/Outbal_write hashes match the repository source manifest and implement the same storage split.
Exact Decimal oracle preserves the canonical 1.3880242022597072e-5 kg N m-2 through same-control-volume storage repartition without tolerance.
The remediated oracle separately verifies a cross-control-volume transfer with an exactly matching typed boundary output and receiver gain.
Authoring CI 34743004052 job 103685788943 is green on exact immutable head 71687d5a981786b406ef6e0234d3f06693af4af8.
negative_controls: Omitting S_cont fails exact storage closure.
Counting a same-control-volume internal transfer again as boundary output creates a false imbalance.
Omitting a required boundary output for a cross-volume transfer leaves the source control volume unclosed.
No residual-derived physical state, silent legacy-field redefinition, process-law inference, B3 admission or production change is permitted.
residual_uncertainty: The physical dry-phase identity and all dry-period process laws remain unqualified.
The scientifically correct rewetting receiver, activation and kinetics remain unqualified.
A future implementation must choose versioned public output representation and qualify restart/serialization behavior.
Same-agent GOV05 review is not genuinely independent.
